questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No R is a G.

II. All G’s are H.

**Conclusions:**

I. No H is a R.

II. No G is a R.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Statement:

I. No R is a G.

II. All G’s are H.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcd7293c3fb7de431b9b3662930929efe368a53acb064beeed0078427d1093c6.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) No H is a R - False (Some H is definitely not R, but all No is a R can be possible not definite).

(ii) No G is a R - True (Because No R is a G, so No G is a R).

Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Amit, Bablu, Ramesh, Deepak, Imran, Sunil, and Sanju are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre. Amit does not sit adjacent to Imran and Sanju. Bablu does not sit adjacent to Amit. Sanju sits second to the left of Imran. Ramesh sits fourth to the left of Amit. Deepak and Bablu sit adjacent to each other. Who sits immediate right of Amit?
questions.solution:
Given: Amit, Bablu, Ramesh, Deepak, Imran, Sunil, and Sanju are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre. 

1) Sanju sits second to the left of Imran.

2) Amit does not sit adjacent to Imran and Sanju.

3) Ramesh sits fourth to the left of Amit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7393f914c08740b1e933e3ddb7ef0b762a26d559983a130ef0125c688e9e6725.png] 

 

4) Bablu does not sit adjacent to Amit. 

5) Deepak and Bablu sit adjacent to each other. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/940650b508d7f0f990e0739e592661d1641d58f3e6a41a79a7796986a5e2f821.png] 

And, Sunil will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8db825fe8d56d0abcd315e26c90a3befcc18a585fb77809de95bd33c08ba3f4.png] 

Here, Sunil sits immediate right of Amit.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sunil"**.

questions.question: Among five persons A, B, C, D and E, who are of different ages, A is younger than only D and E. E is younger than D and older than B. C is the youngest. Who is the fourth oldest?
questions.solution:
Given: Five persons A, B, C, D and E. 

1) C is the youngest.

__ > __ > __ > __ > C

2) A is younger than only D and E. 

D/E > E/D > A > __ > C

3) E is younger than D and older than B.

D > E > A > B > C

So, B is the fourth oldest.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B"**.
